parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description:
**Filter by listing attributes (year, mileage, rooms, …).** Optional. Comma-separated clauses, all of
which must match (AND); up to 12. Attribute ids, types and option ids come from /category-filters.

- `:`  -  a drop-down value, e.g. `166:624` (Year 2015)
- `:|`  -  any of several values (OR), e.g. `166:1048|1056`
- `:-`  -  a range, e.g. `57:0-50000` (mileage in km); open ends `57:100000-`, `57:-50000`;
  `0-0` means exactly 0
- `:`  -  an exact number, e.g. `46:2` (2 rooms)
- `:1`  -  a yes/no feature the seller ticked, e.g. `65:1` (pool); `:0` matches only an explicit
  "no", not "doesn't have it"

Example: `166:1048|1056,57:0-80000` = 2021 or 2022 models with at most 80,000 km.

- **Filterable:** drop-down, number and yes/no attributes with `scope: listing`, including
  `filterable: false` ones.
- **Not filterable:** `text`, `file` and `multi_selection` attributes (a text value is a 400), and
  `scope: category` attributes, which never match.
- A malformed clause is a 400 that shows the expected syntax.

  or `category.category_id` on any listing card.
- An unknown id returns **404** with a message saying so.
- The whole subtree is searched: `2897` (Used Cars) covers every make and model beneath it, and a
  navigation group such as `1540` (Automotive) covers all of its children. One id per request.

page.description:
**Page number, 1-based.** Default `1`; accepts 1 - 40,000.

- Walk pages until `listings` comes back empty; a page past the end returns an empty `listings` array,
  not an error.

  40,000th match is a 400; narrow the request with filters (price, `attributes`, districts, a more
  specific query) to reach the rest.

page_size.description:
**Rows per page.** Default `20`; accepts 1 - 50. Larger values are rejected with 400.

walking pages.

min_price.description:

e.g. `1000`.

- Accepts 0 - 999,999,999.

max_price.description:

e.g. `300` for a monthly rent.

  so `max_price=0` returns exactly the listings without a price.
- `min_price` above `max_price` is a 400.
- Accepts 0 - 999,999,999.

district_ids.description:

e.g. `54` (Salmiya) or `54,69`; any of them may match (OR). Up to 30 ids.

  blocks, an area (e.g. `54` Salmiya) covers its blocks.

/promoted-listings). Any explicit `sort` orders them in with the rest and counts them in `total`; on
most categories a `district_ids` filter does the same.

- Services: `professional-business-services`, `financial-services`, `technology`, `education`

tags.description:
**Keep businesses carrying these tags.** Optional. Comma-separated tag slugs, e.g. `coffee` or
`coffee,desserts`; up to 10.

- With several tags a business must carry ALL of them.
- Tag slugs come from `tags[].slug` on any business (e.g. `bakery-2` is the slug of the tag named
  `bakery`).
- A tag no business carries simply matches nothing (an empty list).

sort.description:
